name: reveal6-animation
title: Reveal 6 Animation
description: The widest noise wavelength of the set, then blurred by ten — the mask opens as one soft swelling blob rather than a ragged hole. The two words start centred on a full screen, then FLIP into the layout below as the mask opens under them — one scrubbed timeline drives the title move, the mask and the image together. One of seven on-scroll SVG filter reveals from Codrops' OnScrollFilter (MIT, Codrops), split into a component per reveal.
